thread:
maria: Heads-up team — proposing onboarding checklist + SLA-driven canary plan for goldenrod-7b-int8. Need sign-off from infra + eval before we schedule dedicated capacity.

maria: TL;DR: target use-case = low-latency chat assistant on Hosted and Dedicated. Goal = keep p95 latency < 250ms hosted, < 200ms dedicated, and no >1.5% QA regression on our prompt evals.

owen: +1. Can you paste the rollout steps? want the gating criteria explicit.

maria: Copy below — rough draft:
```
1) Intake + smoke (local): run model load, sample gen on dev nodes, perf profile (seq=256/512), mem checks.
2) Quant experiments: int8 static + per-channel quant test on small shard; compare quality delta vs fp16.
3) Eval suite: run internal prompts (1000 cases), measure BLEU/ROUGE-ish metrics, hallucination heuristics, and embedding drift. Pass threshold = no >1.5% drop on accuracy score and embedding L2 < 0.08.
4) Canary hosted (0.5% traffic): 24h, compare p95 latency and cost per token. If any error spikes or latency > threshold, auto-scale back and alert.
5) Dedicated canary (staged): 1 host pool, no autoscale, run synthetic QPS to saturate to 80% capacity for 6h. Monitor tail latency and memory.
6) Gradual ramp: 0.5% -> 5% -> 20% -> 50% with A/B eval comparisons at each step.
7) Fallbacks: goldenrod-int8 -> goldenrod-fp16 (same arch) -> raven-13b-int8 (compatible). Auto-fallback policy enforced at 3x error spike or p95 > SLA for >10m.
8) Postmortem + metrics digest after 72h full traffic: cost delta, latency p50/p95/p99, quality metrics, and user-facing error rates.
```

maria: Important gating: pass quant experiment (quality within threshold) AND canary hosted p95 < 250ms for 24h with error_rate <0.5% before Dedicated reservation.

liam: For the quant experiments — do we have an eval harness that exercises long-context behavior? need to watch KV-cache correctness.

maria: Yep — eval-bot will run the kv/end-to-end tests. Also adding a synthetic prefix-cache test to the harness.

eval-bot: Running goldenrod-7b-int8 kv-cache regression suite (seeded tests) — 120 cases. Expected pass rate >= 98%. Will post results to #eng-ml once done.

sophia: Ops note: for Dedicated canary, we should pin CUDA/cuDNN versions and specify kernel selection to avoid perf cliffs across hosts. Add a compatibility matrix step.

maria: Good call. Adding 'compat matrix' to step 1. Also we'll log kernel selection and commit ids in the rollout metadata.

anna: +1 on SLA gating. One more: add rollback ticket template and immediate on-call pager routing if error_rate >1% for 5m.

maria: Added rollback template and pager action. Example rollback play (short):
```
- Pause incoming canary weighting.
- Route traffic to fallback model.
- Open incident, capture logs: model stdout, runtime traces, perf profiles.
- Revert config change in infra repo (if was config), redeploy previous model variant.
```

nowen: Quick Q on metrics: can we get token-level cost delta during canary? need to validate cost/perf tradeoffs (int8 might change token throughput).

liam: We can instrument tok/sec and tokens-per-gpu-hour. ops should expose a dashboard for that.

deploy-bot: Canary job started for goldenrod-7b-int8 on hosted (0.5%). Job id: cb-9853. Tracking: https://ci.internal/deploys/cb-9853

maria: Awesome. I'll hold off on Dedicated reservation until eval-bot posts quant scores and hosted canary runs 24h with no gating fails. Please react with :white_check_mark: when you reviewed checklist and SLA numbers.

owen: Reviewed. :white_check_mark:

liam: Reviewed. minor comment in GH PR about logging, will add. :white_check_mark:

sophia: Reviewed, added compat matrix entry. :white_check_mark:

anna: Reviewed, ok to proceed with hosted canary. :white_check_mark:

eval-bot: goldenrod-7b-int8 kv-cache regression results: 119/120 pass (99.2%), quant quality delta = 0.9% avg degradation on eval score. Posting artifacts to https://artifacts.internal/goldenrod-quant-1855001234

deploy-bot: Hosted canary 0.5% running for 26h. p95=238ms, error_rate=0.34%, cost/token +6%. No regressions flagged by canary monitors.

maria: Given pass, I'll open a Dedicated reservation request and schedule the staged Dedicated canary next week. Thanks all — will create the rollout ticket with links to artifacts and metrics.

owen: Thanks — nice and tidy plan.
